answer: Trust climbs toward a zenith only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work-receipts arriving through one narrow inlet; each endorsement is a non-transferable juniper berry that ripens slowly over epochs. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single funding root, so every endorsement traces back through that lone inlet and never spans distinct clusters, leaving the clone standing far below the zenith. The farm must buy a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head (linear cost), while an honest agent pays once.
